title: Design System: Personal Software Engineer Portfolio

label.purpose: Code, tags, and compact metadata only.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); font:600 14px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:color 200ms ease-out,border-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { color:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px dashed var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.css: .ds-nav { color:var(--foreground); font:600 14px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; text-underline-offset:6px; } .ds-nav:hover { color:var(--accent); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px dashed var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Topic Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { color:var(--accent); font:700 13px/1 JetBrains Mono,monospace; text-decoration:none; } .ds-tag:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline:2px dashed var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio is a carefully edited engineering record: compact, legible, and confident enough to let the work speak.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second decorative accent within a theme.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, glass layers, or simulated floating cards.

dos: Do use the existing theme tokens and one accent per theme.
Do provide intentional empty, missing-file, keyboard, and reduced-motion states.
donts: Don't use trendy developer clichés: terminal cosplay, neon gradients, skill meters, excessive animation, or generic technology icon walls.
Don't hide Resume access behind the embedded PDF viewer.
